title: gRPC connection timeout causing microservice cascade failure
symptoms: Logs: grpc._channel._InactiveRpcError: StatusCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. Inventory service calls timing out after 5s. Order service error rate at 40% due to inventory check failures. P99 latency: 8000ms. Total gRPC timeout errors: 2000/minute.
root_cause: The inventory service was upgraded and a new database index was being built in the background on the inventory table (42M rows). The index build held a brief lock during metadata updates causing query times to spike from 50ms to 6000ms. The gRPC deadline was set to 5s with no retry.
fix_applied: 1. Rolled back inventory service to previous version. 2. Rebuilt index using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (no locking). 3. Increased gRPC deadline to 15s with retry on DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. 4. Implemented circuit breaker: fail fast after 50% errors in 10s window. 5. Added inventory service latency SLO alert at P99 > 500ms.
